title: Rock Monsters! 2010-2019
description: A definitive selection of rock and indie anthems from the 2010s! Starting with My Chemical Romance in 2010 right through to Liam Gallagher at the end of the decade.

title: 30 Rock & Indie Heroes of the 20s
description: Claire Sturgess has the finest from the 20s! From lockdown to a full-blown guitar revolution! Expect legends like Sum 41 & Green Day plus new names like Sam Fender & Yungblud.

title: The New Legends Of Rock
description: Rock Riffs, indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2010 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy & loads more.

title: 99 Reasons The 00s Rocked!
description: 99 anthems of rock from the noughties! With Green Day, Linkin Park, The Strokes, Paramore, Blink-182, The Killers & much more.

title: Rated Rock! The No.1s
description: Number 1 rock songs from the last 50 years! With mega hits from the Arctic Monkeys & KOL right back to legends like The Stones & T.Rex.

title: Rick Wakeman's WILD Things!
description: Remember when rock was WILD? From '64 to '74 the pioneering heroes presented by a man who was at the centre of it all - from The Kinks to The Beatles to Black Sabbath to Queen.

title: Don't Stop! 30 Feelgood Rock Hits
description: From Peter Frampton and Free to Foreigner & Fleetwood Mac - the 70s was a feelgood and carefree time for pop and rock, and we bring back that vibe with 30 of the absolute best.

title: Party Rock Anthems!
description: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.

title: Sunday Rock Classics
description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more.

description: Rock & Roll started as a rebellion and Nicky Horne brings you the 25 people who pushed all the boundaries & refused to conform! These are the greatest Rock Rebels of all time.
